# FBX SDK Installers

Contains embedded FBX SDK 2020.3.9 installers for all platforms.

- `fbx_win.exe` - Windows (VS2022)
- `fbx_linux.tar.gz` - Linux (GCC)
- `fbx_mac.pkg.tgz` - macOS (Clang)

GitHub Actions auto-extracts these during CI builds.

**License**: Autodesk FBX SDK (Proprietary, free for development)
